steps.note: Inspect. The records in scope are listed, and any skipped file is reported.
Partition. The records are cut into chunks, each read on its own.
Map. Each chunk is checked against this skill's rules, one chunk at a time.
Compare. Each benefit's cost is matched to its quote, and each benefit to its eligibility rule.
Verify. Each cited line is re-read, and a finding that does not hold is dropped.
Report. Status: draft for the owner to review. It is not a decision.

outcome.verdict: 1 cost per head does not follow from its quote

findings.title: Cost per head does not follow from the quote
findings.fix: Recompute the cost from the quote

findings.title: Renewal change with no reason
findings.fix: Ask the broker for the reason in writing

example:

pros: Checks a cost per head that does not follow from the quote, a renewal change with no reason, and a benefit with no eligibility rule.
cons: Not checked: Insurance terms beyond the quote.
input: The records for this review, as text or CSV
output: A draft report: findings with location, fix and a not-checked list
prompt: Use the rlm-hrc-benefits-review skill on the records for this review.
